the fabrication and assembly of intelligent materials is an essential component of biomimetics and bioinspired engineering.

the design of intelligent material interfaces that can be used in bioinspired and/or biomimetic devices to sense and control the environment and/or the behavior of cells and tissues.
the development of new materials, fabrication methods, and device designs for the next generation of bioinspired and biohybrid systems.
